caption: The disk moves the block by DMA for 40 ms while the CPU runs the application. At 40 ms the CPU spends 5 ms entering the interrupt and 10 ms in the disk ISR, so the application resumes at 55 ms and runs 45 ms more — 85 ms of application time in the 100 ms window.

spec.aria: A timeline from 0 to 100 ms: the disk does DMA from 0 to 40 ms while the CPU runs the application; the CPU then spends 40 to 45 ms entering the interrupt and 45 to 55 ms in the disk ISR, and the application resumes from 55 to 100 ms.
